title: Amadeus type gathering?
content: I was in an old hotel in my dream. Someone posted a pic of the lobby earlier of a haunted mansion and this hotel reminded me of it! In my dream I was in attendance for some wedding and the staff was dressed as mimes and large playing cards. The mimes were not traditional, and were instead in head to toe black cat suits that covered their faces as well. It wasn’t menacing and I laughed at it. It seemed like they were all in on the joke?! I went outside for a little because I felt out of place there and walked right into a funeral procession. We backed up and went back in and sat in the audience to attend this wedding. Anyone else have any experiences similar to this one?
